azure.monitor.alerts.dynamic_threshold.note: Dynamic thresholds, per time series, on top of the time series itself. Global meter

azure.monitor.alerts.metric_series.note: Metric alert, per time series monitored. The first 10 a month are free (https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/details/monitor/), given in the price list as the zero-priced first tier. Global meter: the free time series are counted over every metric alert of the account (the page does not say more)
